name: Mada Reconciliation Status
query:
SELECT
  settlement_date AS "Date:Date:100",
  terminal AS "Terminal:Link/Mada Terminal:150",
  settlement_no AS "Settlement No:Data:120",
  amount AS "Amount:Currency:120",
  bank_amount AS "Bank Amount:Currency:120",
  difference AS "Difference:Currency:110",
  status AS "Status:Data:120",
  source AS "Source:Data:110",
  bank_matched_on AS "Matched On:Date:100"
FROM `tabMada Settlement`
ORDER BY settlement_date DESC, creation DESC
